findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: unblock, instagram, google-maps, youtube, twitter, reddit, amazon, google-search, google-maps-reviews, youtube-transcript, screenshot, linkedin-jobs, amazon-reviews, web-search, x-replies, youtube-comments, tiktok-comments, instagram-comments, search-plus · Private data: unblock, instagram, tiktok, reddit, google-search · Public sink: unblock, instagram, linkedin, twitter, google-maps-reviews, youtube-transcript, screenshot, linkedin-jobs, indeed-jobs, google-news, amazon-reviews, web-search, x-replies, youtube-comments, tiktok-comments, instagram-comments · Destructive: unblock, feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: unblock, instagram, google-maps, youtube, twitter, reddit, amazon, google-search, google-maps-reviews, youtube-transcript, screenshot, linkedin-jobs, amazon-reviews, web-search, x-replies, youtube-comments, tiktok-comments, instagram-comments, search-plus · Private data: unblock, instagram, tiktok, reddit, google-search · Public sink: unblock, instagram, linkedin, twitter, google-maps-reviews, youtube-transcript, screenshot, linkedin-jobs, indeed-jobs, google-news, amazon-reviews, web-search, x-replies, youtube-comments, tiktok-comments, instagram-comments · Destructive: unblock, feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
